jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
Company Description
Monterey Bay AI is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing responsible and accessible artificial intelligence within the Monterey Bay region and beyond. The organization focuses on education, community engagement, and collaborative projects that help individuals, schools, and local organizations understand and leverage AI in ethical and practical ways. As a mission-driven nonprofit, Monterey Bay AI works closely with diverse community partners to ensure that AI benefits are shared broadly and equitably. Team members have the opportunity to contribute to impactful initiatives that support learning, innovation, and public understanding of emerging technologies.
Role Description
The Community Outreach Coordinator is a full-time, hybrid role based in Monterey, CA, with some work-from-home flexibility. This role involves planning and executing outreach activities, including community events, workshops, and informational sessions that promote Monterey Bay AI’s programs and mission. The coordinator will build and maintain relationships with local organizations, schools, volunteers, and community groups, and serve as a primary point of contact for partnerships and collaborations. Day-to-day tasks include organizing volunteer efforts, managing outreach communications (email, social media, and newsletters), tracking participation and feedback, and supporting grant or donor communications related to community initiatives. The role also includes collaborating with internal teams to align outreach efforts with program goals and reporting on outreach impact to leadership.
Qualifications

Strong interpersonal skills and a commitment to inclusive, respectful engagement with diverse communities.
Excellent communication abilities, including clear written and verbal communication and public speaking comfort.
Demonstrated cooperation and collaboration skills when working with staff, volunteers, and external partners.
Experience or interest in community outreach, including planning and conducting community-facing events and programs.
Volunteer management experience or the ability to recruit, organize, and support volunteers effectively.
Organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines.
Proficiency with common office and communication tools (e.g., email platforms, spreadsheets, presentation software; familiarity with social media is a plus).
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Communications, Nonprofit Management, Education, or Community Development) or equivalent practical experience.
Interest in artificial intelligence, technology education, or nonprofit work; prior experience in these areas is beneficial but not required.
Ability to work on-site in Monterey, CA on a regular basis and to work independently when remote.

jobs.description:
In collaboration with the interdisciplinary team, the Case Manager provides care coordination services evaluating options and services required to meet an individual's health care needs to promote cost-effective, quality outcomes. Serves as a consultant to members of the health care team in the management of specific patient populations. The role integrates the functions of complex case management, utilization management, quality management, discharge planning assessment, and coordination of post-hospital care services, including transfers to an alternative level of care. As more complex medical treatment options emerge the Case Manager will look to eliminate gaps in the care provided, as well as needlessly duplicated treatment, all while controlling the cost of quality patient care. The Case Manager will leverage their clinical and social work experience to ring an understanding of the clinical process of assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation to the process of case management. Some of the major duties of a Case Manager include: Documenting patients' case management plans and on-going activities; Identifying patients 'insurance coverage or other sources of payment for services; Identifying and addressing patient risk factors and/or obstacles to care; Identifying patient needs, current services, and available resources, then connecting the patient to services and resources to meet established goals; Communicating the care preferences of patients, serving as their advocate, and verifying that interventions meet the patient's needs and treatment goals; Screening patients and/or population for healthcare needs; Developing a patient-focused case management plan; and Educating the patient/family/caregiver about the case management process and evaluating their understanding of the process. Some of the major duties of the Case Manager overlap into inpatient duties including: Concurrent review of all patients to validate that the appropriate patient status is assigned upon admission and prior to discharge; InterQual or MCG reviews are completed within 24 hours of admission; Observation patients are effectively care managed on a daily basis; and Facilitate throughput and timely discharges throughout inpatient level of care.

Essential Duties

Clinical Care Coordination 1. Able to effectively manage a case load, supporting up to 100 commercial outpatients. 2. Utilizes the on line work list to manage daily assigned caseload, as assigned by the Lead Ambulatory Care Manager. 3. Assess physical and biopsychosocial needs of the patient through clinical assessment and utilizing data from multiple sources, as supported by the ambulatory care coordinator. 4. Analyze and interpret data in collaboration with patient, family, physician, health care team to develop a plan of care, and as supported by the ambulatory care coordinator. 5. Ensures that a specific plan of care is in place for all patients. As supported by the ambulatory care coordinator, timely completion of all tasks, from the plan of care. Provide coordination of care such as schedule patients’ appointments, arrange transportation, etc. as outlined in policy and procedures. 6. Actively participates in interdisciplinary meetings and team huddles. 7. Answer phone calls from providers, facilities, or patients, related to the status and processing of requests received from ambulatory care management nurse. 8. Assesses ongoing discharge planning needs and documents is computer system as changes to the plan occur. 9. Demonstrates collaborative working relationship with social workers to ensure patient psychosocial needs are met. 10. Demonstrates collaborative working relationship with care team members, including pharmacy, behavioral health, field team, office staff, and facility staff. 11. Completes Medicare One Day Stay forms timely. 12. Completes disposition form for medicare patients timely.
Consultant 1. Demonstrates sound clinical knowledge base regarding CM standards, UM standards, clinical standards of care, NCQA requirements, CMS guidelines, Milliman guidelines, InterQual guidelines, Medicaid/Medicare contracts and benefit systems, and employee health plans. 2. Serves as a consultant to the health care team to identify financial issues that may affect care. 3. Participates in the education of health care team members on current healthcare issues impacting best practices industry standards 4. Educates physicians and health care team on program referral criteria.
Leadership 1. Represents the department in a positive and professional manner. 2. Assists with orientation of new staff. 3. Delegates and assists with supervision of Ambulatory Care Management Coordinators. 4. Makes appropriate referrals to supervisor or Medical Director, communicating accurate clinical information. 5. Participates in guideline (MCG and/or InterQual) competency testing as requested by department director or Medical Director.
Outcomes Management 1. Participates in core measure or HEDIS measure processes in identification of appropriate patients. 2. Participates in hospital and med group quality improvement processes and helps identifies opportunities to improve care. 3. Adheres to program policies and procedures.
Patient Advocacy 1. Respects patient/family values, beliefs, and preferences. 2. Responds promptly to patient/family requests. 3. Supports patient/family with end of life issues, making appropriate referrals into palliative care or hospice care. 4. Include patient/family in care decisions and developing plans of care.
Patient Education 1. Assist health care team with identification of patient/family educational needs for discharge. 2. Inform patient/family of discharge plans. 3. Work with Transitions of Care process, to deliver post acute services to address educational needs to ensure a safe discharge plan. 4. Work with patient/family to learn Self-Management methods for on-going monitoring and treatment of chronic conditions.
Resource Management 1. Proposes alternative treatment options to ensure a cost effective and efficient plan of care. 2. Identifies and creates solutions to remove barriers that may impede optimal patient care. 3. Complete case management care plans, including tasks and interventions, that effectively prevent ER Visits, Hospital admissions, or Re-admissions. 4. Maintains awareness of current managed care contract requirements. 5. Coordinate the management of all in-patient activities/processes, including but not limited to concurrent and retrospective reviews, authorization of appropriate lengths of stay, authorization of appropriate discharge services and equipment, and documentation of all authorized and/or denied in-patient services. 6. Direct pertinent clinical information/questions to contracted in-patient Hospitalists, PCPs, Medical Director and/or Director of Health Services. 9. Completes clinical reviews and plans of care timely and communicates to appropriate care team members. 11. Able to prioritize clinical reviews, caseloads, census loads, and assignments. 12. Other duties as requested or assigned.

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.

Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:

Customer First: We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality: True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design: We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal: Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.
Social & Environmental Responsibility: We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.

Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

OUR TEAM AND SUCCESS

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.

If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

Staff Data Analyst

Our Story

Quince was founded to challenge the idea that exceptional quality must come with an exceptional price tag. Our mission is simple: create products that match or exceed the quality of leading luxury brands and offer them at radically lower prices.

Our Values

Everyone Should Be Able to Afford Nice Things

Quality shouldn't be a luxury. We are committed to making the world's highest-quality products accessible at affordable prices.

Quality Is More Than Materials

True quality comes from both premium materials and exceptional craftsmanship.

We Focus on the Essentials

From the perfect cashmere sweater to hotel-quality bedding, we create thoughtfully designed essentials that elevate everyday life.

We're Innovating to Make Unreal Prices a Reality

Our factory-direct model eliminates unnecessary markups, allowing us to deliver exceptional products at unmatched value.

Always a Better Deal

We believe in radical price transparency for both our customers and manufacturing partners, creating better outcomes for everyone.

Fair Factories

We partner with factories that meet rigorous global standards for workplace safety, ethical practices, and wage fairness.

Our Team

Quince is a retail and technology company founded by leaders with deep experience across retail, technology, and high-growth startups. You'll work alongside exceptional talent from organizations including Stanford GSB, Wish, D.E. Shaw, Stitch Fix, Urban Outfitters, Wayfair, McKinsey, Nike, and many others.

The Opportunity

Quince is seeking a talented and highly analytical individual to join our Growth organization. In this role, you will own measurement and analytics across our growth marketing channels, helping the team make faster, smarter, and more effective investment decisions.

You will develop and maintain attribution frameworks, incrementality testing programs, and performance measurement systems to understand what drives customer acquisition and where marketing dollars generate the greatest return. Over time, you will become a trusted expert on growth performance across the Quince platform, partnering closely with marketing leadership to surface insights, run experiments, and build scalable analytics capabilities that support the company's rapid growth.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a highly analytical problem solver who is excited about using data, technology, and experimentation to drive business growth. You thrive in fast-paced environments where ambiguity is common and answers are not always readily available.

You are energized by ownership, move quickly without sacrificing rigor, and enjoy working in a culture that values data-driven decision-making, intellectual curiosity, and high standards. You are comfortable collaborating across functions and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Responsibilities

Own marketing attribution and measurement frameworks across growth channels, including paid search, paid social, affiliate, and other acquisition programs
Design, execute, and analyze incrementality tests and experimentation programs to measure causal marketing impact
Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting for growth marketing and company leadership
Develop automated monitoring systems to ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and timely insights
Create scalable analytics tools and processes that accelerate decision-making across the Growth team
Partner closely with marketing leadership to translate data into actionable channel, audience, and budget recommendations
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance changes, and uncover key business drivers
Apply statistical and predictive modeling techniques to improve marketing efficiency and performance
Support advanced measurement initiatives, including marketing mix modeling (MMM), attribution modeling, and forecasting
Partner cross-functionally with Data, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to improve measurement infrastructure and business understanding
Preferred: Support app measurement and mobile attribution initiatives

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
5–7 years of experience in analytics, data science, or quantitative business roles, preferably focused on growth marketing, ecommerce, or performance marketing
Hands-on experience building attribution models and designing incrementality or experimental measurement frameworks
Demonstrated ability to independently scope, execute, and communicate complex analyses that drive measurable business impact
Advanced SQL skills and strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, modeling, and automation
Familiarity with major advertising platforms and measurement ecosystems, including Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar channels
Experience applying statistical methods and predictive modeling to business problems; experience with marketing mix modeling is a plus
Strong understanding of experimentation design, causal inference, and marketing measurement best practices
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to improve productivity, analysis, and insight generation
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to delivering exceptional results

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: $207,000 USD - $235,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

jobs.description:
Rose Brooks Center, a nonprofit domestic violence agency, seeks a Housing Navigator whose primary role is to provide step-by-step support to survivors of domestic violence who present to the region's Coordinated Entry System (CES) for homelessness diversion and housing assistance. This position is responsible for conducting outreach to, and Coordinated Entry assessments with, survivors at Rose Brooks Center, other victim service agencies, and other Coordinated Entry access points.

The Housing Navigator assists survivors referred through or diverted from the Coordinated Entry System through all stages of the housing process, including housing search, application, inspection, and placement. This position is also responsible for identifying, developing, and maintaining relationships with local property managers and owners to help mitigate barriers to housing and expedite housing placement. The Housing Navigator reports to the Director of Housing and Economic Advocacy.

Other Aspects Of The Position

Perform all job responsibilities in accordance with agency policies and procedures while demonstrating proficiency in all RBC competencies and utilizing the principles of trauma-informed care and accessibility. Demonstrates a commitment to the overall mission of Rose Brooks Center.
Maintain awareness about the risks of secondary trauma and understand one’s own responsibility of self-care.
Attend scheduled staff, team, and supervision meetings.
Participate in all required trainings.

Qualifications

Required:

Two years of case management experience, preferably in a domestic violence agency and /or commensurate experience.
Knowledge of domestic violence and familiarity with strengths-based perspective.
Demonstrated skills in time management, organization and prioritization.
Ability to work collaboratively and cooperatively with others, both internally and externally.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with community partners.
Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, database systems and other software.
Ability to maintain accurate, timely documentation of services.
Valid driver’s license and proof of liability insurance.

Preferred

Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or related field or commensurate work experience.
Two years of advocacy experience.
Experience in crisis response and working with survivors of domestic/sexual violence trauma.
Knowledge of Department of Housing and Urban Development guidelines.
Bilingual Spanish/English.

Hours

This is a full-time, exempt position (average of 40 hours per week). Some evening hours may be required to accommodate participants’ schedules, and occasional weekend hours may be necessary. This position requires the ability to share a workspace/office environment with others.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
This position falls into a salary range starting at $48,000 annually (exempt) and offers a comprehensive benefits package.

The Community Based Care Coordinator I – Arkansas with oversight from the care coordination team is the member concierge and is the single point of contact for assessment, person-centered planning, service coordination (funded or unfunded), disease management and transitions between all levels of care.

Essential Functions

Understand and implement person-Centered thinking
Facilitate the person-Centered planning process
Assist with in person-centered care training to maximize the development of the Person-Centered Service Plan.
Coordinate services and health benefits for members who meet criteria
Consult with members, families and legally responsible people to discuss behavioral and physical health care needs
Consult and collaborate with other professionals and community members to coordinate care and develop Person-Centered Service Plans
Assist with ongoing communication with the internal complex clinical team.
Assist with educating members about their condition, medication and assist with any necessary instruction.
Monitor service delivery to ensure appropriateness of care and compliance with any waiver
Complete psychosocial health care questionnaires and behavioral assessments by gathering information from the member, family, provider and other stakeholders
